title: Dozens arrested in major anti-LGBTQ raids in Turkey

blocks.text: ISTANBUL — Turkish police on Sunday swooped on gay bars and the homes of LGBTQ activists, arresting at least 60 people in raids authorities said were aimed at boosting traditional family values, officials and activists said.
